verdict.rationale: Mesh has its own permission model. An IAM roles endpoint is gated by a named "View roles in account" permission, API credentials have configurable permissions under Settings > Access Management, and actions such as "Monitor and unmonitor customers" are tied to specific permissions. This shows role-based gating of administrative actions exists, but the evidence never shows how roles are defined or assigned to users, or that investigation actions are restricted by role. missing for 10: documentation of creating and assigning user roles, explicit role gating of case investigation and decision actions, a granular permission catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.
